name: maker
summary: Hobby or hardware projects whose knowledge lives in binaries (3D models, slicer settings, photos) plus what you learned from each attempt. Many small projects sharing one machine, materials and lessons.

work_folders.projects: one folder per physical project: source/ exports/ gcode/ PROJECT.md (file guide + attempt log)
work_folders.profiles: machine and material presets (slicer profiles, filament settings)
work_folders.experiments: controlled tests (porosity, tolerance, overhang) with a sample map and results

init_questions: Machine(s), nozzles, build plate, and the materials you actually use (brand + type)?
The three things you keep telling agents to do differently?
Should I inventory the loose files and propose a move into projects/ (dry run first)?
